summary_en: OBIC raised its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 from 47 yen to 53 yen per share, a 6 yen increase, reflecting upward revision of earnings guidance driven by second-quarter performance.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Upward Revision) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
OBIC announced a dividend increase for fiscal year 2027 (ending March 31, 2027). The year-end dividend per share was raised from the previously announced 47 yen to 53 yen, representing a 6 yen increase. The company also revised its full-year earnings forecast upward, with operating profit, ordinary profit, and net income all exceeded compared to the earlier guidance issued on April 21, 2026.

The company stated that the dividend increase was decided based on the second quarter results performance and reflects stronger earnings momentum across revenue and profitability measures. The company emphasized its fundamental policy of maintaining a strong financial foundation while providing stable and continuous shareholder returns. The revised year-end dividend of 53 yen represents recognition of shareholder support and reflects confidence in the company's operational trajectory through the fiscal year-end.
